facts.fact: Lei n.º 13/2026 (Boletim da República of 1 July 2026) creates the Cyber Security Fund at articles 67-71, funded by a flat 1% of prior-year gross revenue of licensed cybersecurity service providers plus state appropriations and donations; operating rules are not yet made, and no collection or payment is stated.

note: Fund assigned by law to cybersecurity, a digital programme; created but not yet shown collecting or paying.
